top_signals.title: Boeing doesn't expect to significantly ramp up 737 Max production until late 2027
top_signals.summary: Boeing is set to brief investors on its aircraft production outlook when it reports quarterly results before the market opens Tuesday.

top_signals.title: Japan eyes using Indian test ranges for powerful missiles and small attack drones
top_signals.summary: Tokyo sent officials to the South Asian nation this month as it eyes the possibility of using the sites, the GSDF's top uniformed officer said.

University of New Mexico hospital diverts ambulances after cyberattack
top_signals.summary: For about two hours on Monday, the organization diverted ambulances to health systems in Albuquerque and Santa Fe. They were forced to suspend outpatient surgeries and appointments for the remainder of the day.

top_signals.title: Festival de Frue offers an antidote to Japan’s samey music festivals
top_signals.summary: The small-scale music festival has carved out its own identity without relying on deep-pocketed sponsors or pandering to the algorithm.

top_signals.title: Ripple, BNY explore using the XRP Ledger to finance approved invoices
top_signals.summary: BNY adds XRP and RLUSD to its custody platform, as Ripple and C2FO test settling invoice payments on the XRP Ledger.
